name: cooked
description: Edit your videos with cooked. from your own Claude chat. All AI runs on your Claude plan.
long_description: Drives the cooked. editor installed on this Mac: list your videos, open the review page, read the notes you leave on it, change the scene, hand back a new round and export. Needs the cooked. plugin installed (or COOKED_PLUGIN set), Python 3 and ffmpeg. Notes arrive only when the chat calls get_notes: MCP cannot wake Claude.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: Every video in the user's cooked. library, newest first: name, folder, status, stage, draft.

tools.name: open_video
tools.description: Start the video's review page and open it in the browser. Returns the page URL.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: Wait for the user to press Send or Approve on the page, then return every note (time, text, words, what is on screen). Returns NO NOTES YET after timeout seconds.

tools.name: show
tools.description: The scene's items (ids, times, boxes) and the words said, to target a change. at: one moment in seconds.

tools.name: scene_ops
tools.description: Apply ops to scene.json (SCENE.md op format), with a one-line why the page shows.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add one item to the scene: text, image, video, shape or audio.

tools.name: resolve_note
tools.description: Mark a note fixed, wontfix or open, with an optional reply the user sees.

tools.name: hand_back
tools.description: The notes were answered in the scene: open the next round on the page (review.py round --scene).

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export what the page shows as one MP4 (the page's Export button). Waits up to timeout seconds.

plugin_dir.title: cooked. plugin folder
plugin_dir.description: Optional. The plugins/ai-editor folder. Empty: the newest one Claude Code installed.
